Non-blocking Events allow your hooks to receive notification asynchronously when an event happens in Authany.



All events will be delivered to the hook, you can filter event by the type in payload.

en.HookConfigurationScreen.signature.descri:
Each webhook event request is signed with a secret key. You must validate the signature to ensure the request originates from Authany. The signature is calculated as the hex encoded value of HMAC-SHA256 of the request body and is set as the HTTP header x-authgear-body-signature.

Learn more about validating the signature
